use_case: Ambient clinical documentation (AI scribe) drafting visit notes from recorded conversations
business_owner: Care Delivery chief medical information officer
vendor_or_model: AI scribe vendor (speech-to-text and language model)
source_evidence: EV-041 (AI tool discovery); EV-057 (AI scribe configuration); EV-051 (vendor BAA)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (documentation); re-tier to Health care if suggestion features are enabled
human_in_the_loop: Provider reviews, edits, signs, and attests every note
applicable_laws: HIPAA (vendor BAA with no-training terms); state recording consent laws (Fla. Stat. 934.03(2)(d) worked example); 45 CFR 92.210 if suggestion features are enabled; FTC Act Sec. 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production (about 400 providers); expansion paused until the language disparity is mitigated

use_case: EHR predictive decision support (sepsis and readmission risk scores)
business_owner: Care Delivery chief medical information officer
data_categories: Vital signs; labs; age; sex; diagnoses (ePHI)
human_in_the_loop: Clinicians decide on every alert; the score never orders treatment
applicable_laws: 45 CFR 92.210(a)-(c) (inputs include age and sex); HIPAA; ONC HTI-1 decision support transparency duties fall on the certified EHR developer (45 CFR 170.315(b)(11))
status: In production; subgroup review and mitigation documentation due 2026-12-31

applicable_laws: HIPAA (BAA); 45 CFR 92.210; FDA device requirements apply to the manufacturer (verify clearance and labeling before use)

use_case: Utilization-management model scoring prior authorization requests (auto-approves requests meeting criteria; routes others with a recommendation)
vendor_or_model: In-house model trained on the Group Data Platform
source_evidence: EV-041 (AI tool discovery); EV-063 (model registry and UM records)
data_categories: Claims; diagnoses; prior authorization requests; age; disability status (PHI)
human_in_the_loop: Model never denies. Nurse reviewers decide routed requests; a physician reviews every expected adverse medical necessity decision (42 CFR 422.566(d))
applicable_laws: 42 CFR 422.101(c)(1)(i); 422.101(b)(6); 422.137(b), (d); 422.566(d); HIPAA; 45 CFR 92.210 (precaution, counsel reviewing); state insurance UM laws (generic)
status: In production with conditions (P10 section 6); no expansion of auto-approval scope until conditions are met

use_case: Fraud, waste, and abuse model flagging provider claims for pre-payment review
human_in_the_loop: Investigators review every flag; no automatic denial
applicable_laws: HIPAA; state prompt-pay and insurance laws (generic)

use_case: Care summary assist: generative summaries of patient documents for SaaS customers' care teams
vendor_or_model: Hosted large language model from a third-party model provider (subcontractor BAA, zero data retention)
source_evidence: EV-041 (AI tool discovery); EV-070 (subcontractor BAA); EV-071 (release notes); EV-098 (61 opt-in customers)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; customers' clinicians may rely on summaries in care decisions
human_in_the_loop: Summaries labeled AI-generated with links to source text; clinicians at customer sites decide
applicable_laws: HIPAA as business associate (164.314(a)(2)(i)(B); 164.504(e)(2)(ii)(D); 164.410(c)(1)); customer BAAs; SOC 2 commitments (system description, CC2.3, CC8.1, CC9.2); FTC Act Sec. 5 (claims); Colorado SB26-189 developer duties under counsel review for Colorado customers (effective 2027-01-01)
status: In production for 61 opt-in customers; new enrollments paused until conditions are met

human_in_the_loop: Engineers review all suggestions; normal code review applies
